name: Terry Payne
headline: Co-Founder & Managing Director at BOSS ERP Consulting
about:
BOSS ERP are specialist ERP recruiters within the SAP and Microsoft Dynamics space, We are a leading supplier to some of the largest SAP customers within EMEA. Our business prides itself of the ability to match accurately and effectively, We are established head hunters who have some of the best networks within ERP to source experienced ERP individuals. 
- BOSS ERP run a transparent service that enables all contractors to understand our commercial agreement with the end client prior to going on site. 
- BOSS ERP has grown significantly in the last 7 years, we are one of the fastest-growing ERP recruitment companies in the UK.

experiences.description:
Founding Director of the BOSS Professional Services Group of companies

BOSS Professional Services are the holding company for BOSS Consulting, BOSS ERP, BOSS Energy, BOSS Sales Solutions, BOSS Procurement and BOSS Medical Sciences. 

BOSS CONSULTING supplies bespoke teams of consultants working solely client side on large transformational ERP implementations. We provide teams who offer both pre-programme and in-flight services on different contractual models depending on client’s needs.

BOSS ERP are a specialist agency that support major ERP organisations in the delivery of ERP Professionals on both a Contract and Permanent basis. We have a very strong reputation for delivery within both SAP, Microsoft and Oracle sectors.

BOSS ERP supplies some of the leading ERP FTSE top 500 companies.

Most of the relationships and business that BOSS ERP have secured is on a referral basis. If you are struggling to find the right person for your ERP Programme then please feel free to contact us and see how we do things differently from your current suppliers.

BOSS ENERGY & BOSS Renewable Energy - Our core vision is to provide the Oil and Gas, Power and associated industries with a more flexible, tailored and overall quality service. We have excellent relationships across the globe with some of the leading Oil and Gas and Energy corporations. 

BOSS MEDICAL SCIENCES – We are a bespoke agency specialising in staffing strategy and supply to the medical device industry. With a team of market experts specialising within niche areas we are able to provide a professional, consultative service to both candidates and clients. 

BOSS SALES SOLUTIONS are the leading supplier of specialist L&D resources in the UK. 

SmarTek Global: have a deep understanding of Smart Energy, Utilities and Digital markets accompanied by an unrivaled network of resources. We provide skilled professionals with in depth knowledge within the Smart Technical vertical

Treadstone ERP Consulting

Treadstone ERP Consulting specialise in the delivery of ERP contract and permanent recruitment specifically within the SAP and Microsoft Dynamics market place.

Treadstone-ERP objective is to create a clear and transparent service that enables us to build strong relationships built on trust with candidates and clients alike.

Within Treadstone, we have dedicated teams that work within vertical market driven environments to enable them to understand both the technology and people within that space. Our teams are structured to allow us to deliver the highest quality contract and permanent staff to our clients, we have dedicated Account Managers, Head Hunters and Resource Consultants that supply and manage our clients’ recruitment needs. 

Why are we different? We offer a transparent service that ensures no contractor will go on site without understanding the commercials for both the client and Treadstone. 

Why do we do this? We want to ensure that all relationships are built on the foundations of trust.  

SAP Modules we specialise in, include: 

SAP HR, SAP FICO, SAP CRM, SAP SRM, SAP SD, SAP MM, SAP IM, SAP WM, SAP PP, SAP PS, SAP QA, SAP QM, SAP PORTALS, SAP BASIS, SAP BW, SAP BI, SAP APO, SAP NETWEAVER, SAP ABAP, SAP BO, SAP BUSINESS ONE, SAP BPC, SAP SCM, IS-U, IS-OIL, IS-RETAIL, SAP XI/PI, SAP GRC 

SAP Positions: Support, System Analyst, Business Analyst, Consultant, Senior Consultant, Project Manager, Programme Manager, Sales / Pre-Sales, Testers, Trainers, Directors
Was responsible for SAP practice within Square One.
Business Manager at Reed Technology Guildford.
